page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-standard-192 is a high-capacity server instance belonging to the c4d server family. It features 192 dedicated virtual CPUs built on the x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 744.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 3.88 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance configuration does not include integrated local storage or bundled GPU hardware accelerators, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. Additionally, the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its massive core count and balanced memory-to-core ratio, the c4d-standard-192 offers high resource density for large-scale parallel processing. It is designed for highly threaded workloads that require substantial compute capacity without the need for local NVMe drives or GPU acceleration. Suitable workloads include large-scale web serving, enterprise application hosting, distributed data processing, and highly parallelized compilation tasks.
